pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, star-like geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Darker pigment concentration is observed in the center of the patches, fading towards the light-colored borders.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, cream-colored negative space pathways with high pixel thickness. The junction nodes are broad and diffuse, creating a continuous interconnected mesh across the flank and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible short, upright mane along the upper neck and shoulder ridge showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the bright background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, localized greyish-blue textural disruption on the mid-to-lower flank, indicating a significant area of skin abnormality or chronic lesion that obscures the typical pelage pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a prominent, large-scale greyish patch on the lower flank that lacks the typical light-colored corridor network.
